\subsection*{Second-quantization form}

The Hamiltonian in second-quantization reads

\begin{equation}
  H = \sum_{\mathbf{k}} \sum_{m,n} H_{mn}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{m\mathbf{k}} c_{n\mathbf{k}},
\end{equation}

where $H_{mn}(\mathbf{k}) = \sum_{\mathbf{R}} H_{mn}(\mathbf{R})\, e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{R}}$.

Expanded term by term (orbital labels: $\text{V1:}d_{xy}$, $\text{V2:}d_{xy}$, $\text{V3:}d_{xy}$):

\begin{align}
H &= \sum_{\mathbf{k}} \Bigl[
      \varepsilon_{\text{V1:}d_{xy}}\, c^\dagger_{\text{V1:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V1:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}}
    +   \varepsilon_{\text{V2:}d_{xy}}\, c^\dagger_{\text{V2:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V2:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   \varepsilon_{\text{V3:}d_{xy}}\, c^\dagger_{\text{V3:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V3:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{V1:}d_{xy} \to \text{V2:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{V1:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V2:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{V1:}d_{xy} \to \text{V2:}d_{xy}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{V2:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V1:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{V1:}d_{xy} \to \text{V3:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{V1:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V3:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{V1:}d_{xy} \to \text{V3:}d_{xy}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{V3:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V1:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}}
    +   f_{\text{V2:}d_{xy} \to \text{V3:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{V2:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V3:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} \\
  &\quad +   f_{\text{V2:}d_{xy} \to \text{V3:}d_{xy}}^*(\mathbf{k})\, c^\dagger_{\text{V3:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}} c_{\text{V2:}d_{xy},\mathbf{k}}
  \Bigr],
\end{align}

where the on-site energies are

\begin{align}
  \varepsilon_{\text{V1:}d_{xy}} &= \operatorname{Re}[H_{\text{V1:}d_{xy},\text{V1:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{0})] = 6.51587\text{ eV} \\
  \varepsilon_{\text{V2:}d_{xy}} &= \operatorname{Re}[H_{\text{V2:}d_{xy},\text{V2:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{0})] = 6.89754\text{ eV} \\
  \varepsilon_{\text{V3:}d_{xy}} &= \operatorname{Re}[H_{\text{V3:}d_{xy},\text{V3:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{0})] = 6.89754\text{ eV}
\end{align}

The structure functions are defined as

\begin{align}
  f_{\text{V1:}d_{xy} \to \text{V2:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{k}) &= -0.297373\,
    - 0.297373\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_2)}
    + 0.028257\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(-\mathbf{a}_1)} \\
  &\quad + 0.028257\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1 + \mathbf{a}_2)} \\
  f_{\text{V1:}d_{xy} \to \text{V3:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{k}) &= -0.297373\,
    - 0.297373\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1)}
    + 0.028257\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(-\mathbf{a}_2)} \\
  &\quad + 0.028257\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1 + \mathbf{a}_2)} \\
  f_{\text{V2:}d_{xy} \to \text{V3:}d_{xy}}(\mathbf{k}) &= 0.451534\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(-\mathbf{a}_2)}
    + 0.451534\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1)}
    + 0.027761\, \\
  &\quad + 0.027761\,e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot(\mathbf{a}_1 - \mathbf{a}_2)}
\end{align}
